text:
Silver Price in 2023
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2023, the LBMA silver price rose 3.5% between 2023-01-31 ($23.00) and 2023-12-29 ($23.79). The highest sampled price was $25.02 in November and the lowest was $20.53 in February. The mean of these observations was $23.49. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
